# PostHog node

Use the PostHog node to automate work in PostHog, and integrate PostHog with other applications. n8n has built-in support for a wide range of PostHog features, including creating aliases, events, and identity, as well as tracking pages.

On this page, you'll find a list of operations the PostHog node supports and links to more resources.

**Credentials**

Refer to [PostHog credentials](../credentials/posthog.md) for guidance on setting up authentication.

## Operations

* Alias
    * Create an alias
* Event
    * Create an event
* Identity
    * Create
* Track
    * Track a page
    * Track a screen

## Templates and examples

[Browse PostHog node documentation integration templates](https://n8n.io/integrations/posthog) or [search all templates](https://n8n.io/workflows/)
